scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The theorem is analytic. The bundled deterministic checker verifies algebraic identities and representative numerical projections only; finite tests are not used as proof of the continuum statement.
limitations: The exact formula is restricted to spin-1 states diagonal in a spin-projection basis, up to physical rotations.
The comparison set is the convex hull of spin coherent states, equivalently symmetric separable two-qubit states, not all two-qubit separable states.
The result does not prove the published conjectured pure-state upper envelope for arbitrary mixed spin-1 states.

title: Exact quantumness and closest classical states for diagonal spin-1 mixtures
